CB-01.note: no new-tab page: ⌘T and + New Tab open the bar; a tab exists only once a row is chosen

CB-02.note: ⌘T/Ctrl+T, + New Tab row, macOS File menu; second ⌘T closes

CB-03.note: ⌘L/Ctrl+L/Alt+D: full URL selected, current-page row (Enter reloads), navigates the current tab

CB-04.note: centred in the window (D11b), input ~36% down, 660 px wide, ≤9 rows sized to fit, no scroll bar, Space accent, dark

CB-05.note: tabs, pinned/Favorites, folders, archive, per-profile history, typed URL + autocomplete, past searches, opt-in engine suggestions, actions, Spaces; extensions and settings sections wait for their lanes

CB-06.note: kind label on every row, split favicons, other-Space name, shortcuts, hints, middle-truncated URLs

CB-07.note: one ranked list (src/main/commandbar/rank.ts, tunable), best-guess top row, dedupe tab > archived > history, stable row ids

CB-08.note: inline domain/URL completion from history and tabs; Backspace drops it, →/End accept; scheme added

CB-09.note: switches to the tab (and its Space) instead of duplicating; exact URL match tops the list; ⌥/Alt+Enter opens a copy

CB-10.note: ↑/↓ (⌃N/⌃P on macOS), Enter, hover, aria-activedescendant; ⌘⌥⌫ / Shift+Delete removes history rows

CB-11.note: keyword or site-name prefix + Tab → chip; Backspace/Esc leaves; starter list in settings.siteSearch (editing UI is ST-06)

CB-12.note: Paste and go row first in the empty state; the ⌘⌥V action belongs to TB-02

CB-13.note: every registered action is searchable by name/synonym/initials with its shortcut, tab-only actions hidden on empty Spaces; many catalogue actions do not exist yet

CB-14.note: Tab on an empty field → Actions chip; Esc/Backspace leaves; the '/ ' prefix (P2) is not done

CB-15.note: default engine search row and destination (q=a+b); engine suggestions opt-in (settings.searchSuggestions, off by default), non-blocking with a 1.5 s timeout

CB-17.note: hover × and ⌘⌥⌫ / Shift+Delete delete history and past-search rows

CB-18.note: recent tabs, frequent sites, paste row; starter actions/sites in a fresh profile; current page in ⌘L mode

CB-19.note: results use the window's current Space/profile and re-run on Space switch; new tabs go to the current Space

CB-21.note: Esc, ⌘T/⌘L again, click outside, window blur; text discarded; focus returns to the page

CB-22.note: spring scale-fade entrance, quicker exit, reduced-motion fade; type-ahead and Enter buffered; IME-safe; per-keystroke latency measured

CB-23.note: private (non-persistent) sessions get no history/archive rows; ⌘L on an empty Space acts like ⌘T; split-pane and Mini Window variants not done

KS-04.note: all command bar keys except ⇧Enter (CB-16) and ⌘⌥V (TB-02)

KS-19.note: command bar: ⌘T/⌘L/⌘W/Esc handled by the bar first (ActionRegistry.intercept); other overlays belong to their lanes

FL-16.note: motion spring (0.97→1, 4 px drop), 100 ms exit while focus returns at once; centred in the window

FL-17.note: per-keystroke local results, identity-keyed memoized rows, instant highlight; engine suggestions fill free rows without moving the highlight

CB-20.note: a click over the sidebar closes the bar and is forwarded to the sidebar (one-click tab select); hover-reveal sidebar interplay untested
